A1.evidence: In the travelling touch runs I bought and sold several goods, chose adjacent import districts using current cargo, encountered absent dealers, and changed cargo as local prices changed. Depth limits and the public fleet calendar add choices beyond posted unit prices.
below_10: My route policy was simple; I did not establish several equally viable optimized strategies.

A2.evidence: The travelling run grew from 2500 cash to 98822 cash on night 30 while unpaid debt compounded to 65725. Fixture tests found 0 profitable buy/sell reversals in 336 probes across all seven districts and eight goods. Bank and upgrade costs changed balances correctly.
below_10: Limited independent strategy sample; charter, rumour and bank-heavy strategies were not compared across seeds.

A3.evidence: Touch play exposed escape odds falling with a loaded hold, repeated failed escapes damaging hull, cargo confiscation risk, collectors, squalls, courier offers, crates and gambling. One run sank after choosing to push through a squall with 13% hull.
below_10: I tested escape consequences extensively but did not play all fight/bribe branches or all eight arrival-event outcomes.

A4.evidence: The travelling runs moved from small early purchases to five-figure flips; escalating debt and late-night warnings established a deadline. Night 30 still allowed cargo liquidation before settlement.
below_10: Several middle turns followed repeated import routes; these runs did not establish a satisfying upgrade-and-debt-payoff arc through ordinary play.

C1.evidence: Verified file play, 30-night clock, seven mapped locations, eight goods with history, limited cargo, hold and motor upgrade effects, debt repayment/interest, vault transfers/interest, risky events, settlement and persistent scores. Custom graphics, touch, mouse, keyboard and synthesized audio paths are present.

C2.evidence: SHA256 matched the packet. File is 230005 bytes. Source searches found inline vanilla JS/CSS/SVG, no fetch/XHR/import/external assets, and all localStorage operations inside guarded store methods. Offline WebKit request logs contain only the local HTML navigation. Chromium sandbox=allow-scripts iframe started with no errors despite opaque-origin storage.

C3.evidence: Completed two corrected 30-night WebKit touch completion regressions with clean game error logs; also exercised a travelling run to night 30 and a sinking run to night 17. Corrupt saves, extreme quantities and blocked-storage sandbox startup did not crash the game.
below_10: The two fully settled regression runs stayed at Lanternquay, so they are narrow stability coverage. Travelling runs ended in test-driver errors/early reckoning exit, disclosed separately. Not every event reload stage or repeated new-game timer lifecycle was tested.

C4.evidence: Personally checked negative, zero, fractional, huge, overflowing and blank quantity inputs; zero/invalid disabled purchase and large values clamped. Retested real WebKit typed-quantity touch confirmation: two units bought, cash 2172. Verified 336 nonprofitable immediate reversals, bank 1000→1015, debt 6000→6360, service transfers, score arithmetic, reload persistence and corrupt stored JSON handling.

C5.evidence: Reviewed separated data tables, single S run state, core buy/sell and integrated depth pricing, two persisted RNG streams, guarded storage, queued event outcomes and animation/audio cleanup functions. Actual play produced no game console errors.
below_10: Large monolithic file mixes rendering and mutation through globals. No long-duration memory/timer profiling or representative real-iPhone frame-rate measurement was performed.

strengths: Self-contained offline runtime and guarded persistence passed independent tests.
Readable phone trading sheets retain reachable confirmation controls at short heights.
Integrated depth pricing resisted 336 immediate round-trip exploit probes.
Distinct setting, informative map and explicit encounter odds.
weaknesses: Modal keyboard focus can escape to covered content.
Late repayment copy reports the wrong rate.
Short phone viewports require scrolling to compare all goods and detailed trade information.
No independent proof of broad strategic balance, audible quality or real iPhone behavior.
